notes.title: Countdown Times now stored in profiles.
notes.content:
Hello there folks!

Small update based on some feedback. Saving a profile now also stores any countdown times you're currently using allowing them to be restored when the profile is loaded.

In retrospect, this should have been a feature at launch. I appreciate the feedback!

Best,

5UBL4H

notes.title: It's happening!
notes.content:
Happy October Folks!

Proud to announce that Timing = Everything will release 10/31/2024!

I started this project because I really did want an application like this, but also because I've ALWAYS wanted to publish something on Steam (that I could be proud of). I've started numerous projects in the past and had fun prototyping them, but let's just say they were ambitious projects and I wanted something a bit smaller I could complete in under a year. This project allowed me to learn what start to finish really looks like, and I learned a ton of things along the way that should definitely make larger projects in the future go much smoother.

Thanks to everyone who helped with ideas and testing, but mostly thanks for listening to me yammer.

And you, mysterious reader, if you decide to make the purchase I truly hope it helps and brings you joy.

Best,

5UBL4H
